## Type

## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py` passes locally.
- [ ] Each new/changed `ref` was tested on a fresh React + Tailwind project.
- [ ] `ref` uses the **full registry URL** form, not a namespaced shorthand.
- [ ] `aliases` is a non-empty list covering how a user would *describe* the effect.
- [ ] `library` exists in `code_libraries[]` (showpiece entries only).
- [ ] `license` is filled in and verified against the upstream source.
- [ ] `deps` lists the peer deps a fresh project needs, as a list.
- [ ] No duplicate of an existing entry (checked both names and aliases).
- [ ] No component code pasted into this repo. Entries are pointers only.
